Y uniquely sources M5 to the assignment at :10662 rather than the comment, and finds the :8707-before-:8709 dry-run ordering, autonomy-sweep:1914 and the cc-cloud negative; W finds the /goal-arm gate asymmetry, wrap-ledger:1012 and the exact :2328 skip string, and repairs (c) where Y abstains. 2 bad citations each. XY tie: X is deeper on mechanism and owns the sc_announce falsification and the :44-46 catch; Y has the cleaner citation record (2 vs 3 bad, and zero errors in the wrap-ledger/session-continue blocks), catches two stale citations X misses (handoff-fire:3520 and session-continue:724's ':197'), and honestly abstains where X asserts a wrong replacement site. Trade, not dominance. WZ / XZ / YZ all go against Z on one specific, verified, material difference: Z states eleven path:line locations that do not hold at this sha, including the entire four-rung wrap-ledger ladder (:1965-1975 instead of :1972/:1979/:1981/:1983), the wrap-ledger attribution jq (:1069-1075 instead of :1065-1071), the wake-floor jq (:757-763 instead of :748-754) and its fallback (:770-772 instead of :762) — the exact reads the brief asks to be quoted. Z additionally omits the W3-B1 terminal-close refusal that orders the self-close discharge (K6), the stderr-verdict mechanism at mailbox-drain.sh:576-579 (K7), and the wrap-ledger:1018 stale citation. Its one unique correct find (commands/are-we-done.md:22-23) does not offset that. Length and polish were not weighed; all four are comparably long and well-organised.
